title: Chive and Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta
blurb: A simple pasta with fresh chives, tangy sun-dried tomatoes and a hint of lemon, brought together with starchy pasta water.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the fusilli according to the packet instructions until al dente.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and add the garlic, cooking for about one minute until fragrant.
Add the minced sun-dried tomatoes to the pan and stir for another minute.
Reserve a mugful of pasta water, then drain the pasta.
Add the drained pasta to the pan along with about 100ml of the reserved pasta water, the lemon juice and most of the chopped chives, tossing everything together.
Season with black pepper and a pinch of salt, adding more pasta water if needed to create a light coating sauce.
Serve in bowls with the remaining chives scattered over the top.

ingredients.text: sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained and minced
